activities.description: Lori walks across the room and sits down on a sofa.
Lori tells Leslie she has changed her mind about taking the job with the orchestra.
Lori and Leslie argue about why Lori changed her mind.

characterInteraction.description: Sisters. There is a clear power dynamic with Leslie often taking the lead and Lori feeling resentful.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Lori's outburst reveals a deep-seated resentment that likely stems from years of feeling inadequate in comparison to Leslie. The scene suggests that their relationship is not as close as Leslie believes.

mood.description: Angry. The tense dialogue and frustrated expressions of both characters contribute to the angry mood.

Lori finally reveals her long-held resentment towards always being in Leslie's shadow.
